006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type;
007
008import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
009import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
010import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
011
012/**
013 * Provides a convenient way to raise a
014 * {@link TypeMetapathException#INVALID_TYPE_ERROR}.
015 */
016public class InvalidTypeMetapathException
017    extends TypeMetapathException {
018
019  /**
020   * the serial version UID.
021   */
022  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
023
024  /**
025   * The item associated with this invalid type error, or {@code null} if no
026   * specific item was provided.
027   */
028  @Nullable
029  private final IItem item;
030
031  /**
032   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code item} and {@code cause},
033   * using a default message.
034   *
035   * @param item
036   *          the item related to the invalid type error
037   * @param cause
038   *          the original exception cause
039   */
040  public InvalidTypeMetapathException(
041      @NonNull IItem item,
042      @NonNull Throwable cause) {
043    super(
044        INVALID_TYPE_ERROR,
045        String.format("Invalid data type '%s'", item.getClass().getName()),
046        cause);
047    this.item = item;
048  }
049
050  /**
051   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code item} and no cause, using
052   * a default message.
053   *
054   * @param item
055   *          the item related to the invalid type error
056   */
057  public InvalidTypeMetapathException(
058      @NonNull IItem item) {
059    super(INVALID_TYPE_ERROR, String.format("Invalid data type '%s'", item.getClass().getName()));
060    this.item = item;
061  }
062
063  /**
064   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code item}, {@code message},
065   * and {@code cause}.
066   *
067   * @param item
068   *          the item related to the invalid type error
069   * @param message
070   *          the exception message
071   * @param cause
072   *          the original exception cause
073   */
074  public InvalidTypeMetapathException(
075      @Nullable IItem item,
076      @Nullable String message,
077      @NonNull Throwable cause) {
078    super(INVALID_TYPE_ERROR, message, cause);
079    this.item = item;
080  }
081
082  /**
083   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code item}, {@code message},
084   * and no cause.
085   *
086   * @param item
087   *          the item related to the invalid type error
088   * @param message
089   *          the exception message
090   */
091  public InvalidTypeMetapathException(
092      @Nullable IItem item,
093      @Nullable String message) {
094    super(INVALID_TYPE_ERROR, message);
095    this.item = item;
096  }
097
098  /**
099   * Get the associated item, if provided for the exception.
100   *
101   * @return the item or {@code null} if not item was provided
102   */
103  @Nullable
104  public IItem getItem() {
105    return item;
106  }
107}
